verdict.rationale: llamafile is a local LLM runtime with an HTTP server, so concurrency capacity is a fair question to ask of it. The pack, however, never documents reserving dedicated capacity or keeping throughput steady under concurrent requests. The only related item is a bare listing of 'slot' options in the server help (llamafile-docs-9), which does not explain what slots do or show any concurrency guarantee, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I know the runtime reserves dedicated capacity so throughput holds steady when multiple agents or sessions issue requests concurrently
